name: qlive-framework-workspace
description: Root front door for the qlive framework developer monorepo. Run pnpm <script>; Maven is invoked under the hood and never needs to be called directly.

scripts.dev-ts: wait-on -t 60000 tcp:8080 || (echo "Nothing is serving :8080 - start the backend in the IDE, or run pnpm dev to have one started" >&2; exit 1) && pnpm --filter @qlivedev/qlive-ts run build && pnpm --filter @qlivedev/qlive-test-frontend dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "node ./tooling/dev-backend.mjs" "wait-on -t 60000 tcp:8080 && pnpm --filter @qlivedev/qlive-ts run build && pnpm --filter @qlivedev/qlive-test-frontend dev"
